# pve_node_usb_devices (Data Source)

Lists the local USB devices of one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/hardware/usb`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_node_usb_devices" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose USB devices to list.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) USB devices currently attached to the node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Identifier in `node` form (same as the `node` attribute).

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `busnum` (Number) The USB bus number.
- `class` (Number) The USB class code.
- `devnum` (Number) The device number on the bus.
- `level` (Number) The hub depth of the device.
- `manufacturer` (String) The manufacturer string reported by the device; null when not reported.
- `port` (Number) The physical port the device is plugged into.
- `prodid` (String) The product ID (e.g. `0x1234`).
- `product` (String) The product string reported by the device; null when not reported.
- `serial` (String) The serial number reported by the device; null when not reported.
- `speed` (String) The negotiated link speed (e.g. `480`).
- `usbpath` (String) The USB path (e.g. `1-2`); null when not reported.
- `vendid` (String) The vendor ID (e.g. `0x8087`).
